title: Terms & Conditions
content:
Using FGX MART

FGX MART is a catalogue-based platform for exploring packed food, clothing, electronics and kitchen utensils. These terms describe use of our website, customer accounts, product selections and enquiries. Please read them before using the service.

Your account and details

You may browse the catalogue and build a cart as a guest. An account is required for checkout, saved addresses, order history and product reviews. Provide accurate information, keep your sign-in details private and contact us if you believe your account has been misused.

Products, prices and availability

Product images, descriptions, options, prices and stock information help you prepare your requirements. Information may change, and adding an item to your cart does not reserve stock. Please confirm the product specification, quantity, availability and current price with FGX MART before finalising your request.

Your cart, PDF and WhatsApp enquiry

You can select products and quantities, continue to checkout and download a PDF proforma invoice. You may then open WhatsApp Support and attach the PDF yourself. Downloading a PDF or opening WhatsApp does not send the document automatically. A product list or proforma invoice records your requested selection; it is not confirmation of payment or dispatch.

Order confirmation and payment

Review your details and any order reference carefully. Our team will confirm the requirements and payment arrangements applicable to your request. The final amount, including any applicable taxes or delivery charges, should be confirmed before payment. Keep your order reference and correspondence for follow-up.

Delivery and changes to a request

Selecting a country or zipcode identifies your shopping location but does not guarantee that every product can be delivered there. Delivery coverage, charges and timing depend on the destination and items requested. Contact us promptly if you need to change or cancel a request; available options depend on its current stage.

Damaged, incorrect or unsuitable items

Contact FGX MART promptly if an item is damaged, incorrect or raises a quality concern. Include your order reference, product details and relevant photos. Our team will explain the next steps and any applicable return, replacement or refund arrangements. These terms do not remove consumer rights that apply by law.

Reviews and acceptable use

Registered customers may submit a star rating and a review about their experience. Please keep reviews relevant, honest and respectful, and do not include private information about other people. You must not misuse accounts, upload harmful content, interfere with the service or use the website for unlawful purposes. Reviews may be withheld from publication where appropriate.

Website content and external services

Website content is provided for using FGX MART and discussing product requirements. Brand names and product images may belong to their respective owners. Links to WhatsApp and other external services take you to services operated by others, whose own terms and privacy practices apply.

Updates and contact

We may update these terms as our service changes. The version displayed on this page is the current website version. For questions about these terms, an enquiry or an order, use the FGX MART contact details displayed in the website footer or checkout.
